result.title: Procedural Adversarial Learning
result.summary: For many computer vision tasks, neural networks can be trained to produce a low average error, yet they still fail on seemingly simple scenes. Reducing these failures requires first finding them, but they may not be in a fixed dataset. We study procedural adversarial learning (PAL), a framework of minimax training and adversarial evaluation which searches the input space of a procedural generator for difficult instances. The procedural generator is an interpretable program mapping a low-dimensional vector of control parameters (e.g. layout, lighting, pose) to a rendered image and its label. We introduce the Simple-PAT algorithm, which uses zeroth-order optimization in the procedural generator's parameter space to propose adversarial training samples that are generated on demand. We also create PAL-Dojo, a collection of efficient procedural generators for surface normal estimation, image segmentation, and human pose estimation. Against a cross-model black-box adversary with 50M aggregate queries, Simple-PAT reduces worst-case error by a geometric mean of 3.15x compared to standard training and 2.63x compared to the strongest robust training baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/procedural-adversarial-learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出程序化对抗学习（PAL）框架，在可解释程序生成器的低维控制参数空间中用零阶优化（Simple-PAT）按需搜索困难样本，并构建 PAL-Dojo 生成器集合，用于表面法向、分割与人体姿态估计的对抗训练与评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由程序参数控制布局、光照、位姿并生成带真值图像」的设定，可能为检验 LVR 是否保留任务必要视觉细节提供可控反事实诊断手段，低维参数搜索困难实例的思路也可供核查评价设计，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态。
